say:1:1536111001:1.text: You've heard of Nazrik, right? There were thirty warriors just as strong as him! Imagine that!
say:1:1536111001:1.source_cn: 你知道那非吗？猎血节上像他那么厉害的战士，足足有三十个！
say:1:1536111001:1.male: You've heard of Nazrik, right? There were thirty warriors just as strong as him! Imagine that!
say:1:1536111001:1.female: You've heard of Nazrik, right? There were thirty warriors just as strong as him! Imagine that!

say:2:1536111002:1.text: He was the only one who made it back. That says a lot about how brutal the Bloodhunt really was.
say:2:1536111002:1.source_cn: 但是最后只有他回来了，这说明猎血节远比我想象的更残酷。
say:2:1536111002:1.male: He was the only one who made it back. That says a lot about how brutal the Bloodhunt really was.
say:2:1536111002:1.female: He was the only one who made it back. That says a lot about how brutal the Bloodhunt really was.

say:3:1536111003:1.text: If I had gone, my unborn child might never have seen the light of day.
say:3:1536111003:1.source_cn: 要是我真去参加了，恐怕我肚子里的孩子就没机会出生了。
say:3:1536111003:1.male: If I had gone, my unborn child might never have seen the light of day.
say:3:1536111003:1.female: If I had gone, my unborn child might never have seen the light of day.
